trap.label: tempo verbal
trap.wrong: If it will rain, we will stay in.
trap.right: If it rains, we will stay in.
trap.why: Português usa o futuro do subjuntivo (“se chover”), mas o brasileiro traduz com will. Depois de if usa-se o presente.

mcq.q: If the bus **___** late, we’ll walk.
If I won the lottery, I **___** travel.
If she had called, I **___** answered.

opts: If I were rich, I would buy it.
If I am rich, I will buy it.
If I had been rich, I would buy it.

fix.wrong: If it will snow, the school closes.
fix.right: If it snows, the school closes.

fix.wrong: If she knew, she would have joined us.
fix.right: If she had known, she would have joined us.

fix.wrong: If we had more time, we will visit Lima.
fix.right: If we had more time, we would visit Lima.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 2º condicional: “If I have time, I will paint.”
rewrite.answer: If I had time, I would paint.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 3º: “If she studies, she passes.”
rewrite.answer: If she had studied, she would have passed.

rewrite.prompt: Passe para o 1º: “If it rained, we would cancel.”
rewrite.answer: If it rains, we will cancel.
